evals.prompt: Tag my most recent trail run
evals.expected_output: A classification card with Purpose, Modality (Trail running), and Time-of-day tag. Purpose should reflect distance/duration/elevation relative to the athlete's thresholds. Hill modifier should appear if elevation > 40 m/km.
expectations: Output contains a PURPOSE field
Output contains a MODALITY field with 'Trail running'
Output contains a TIME field (Morning/Daytime/Evening/Night)
Output includes a 'Why' explanation referencing at least one concrete data point (distance, duration, elevation, or HR zones)
Hill modifier is correctly applied or omitted based on elevation per km calculation (threshold 40 m/km)

evals.prompt: Classify my most recent swimming session
evals.expected_output: Classification card with Modality = Swimming, Purpose = Cross-training (or Recovery if short/easy), Time-of-day derived from start time.
expectations: Output contains a PURPOSE field
Output contains a MODALITY field with 'Swimming'
Output contains a TIME field
Purpose is Cross-training or Recovery (not Aerobic base or Interval unless HR/label strongly indicates otherwise)
No Hill modifier applied (swimming has no elevation)

evals.prompt: What kind of session was my longest run last month?
evals.expected_output: Should find the longest run of the previous calendar month. For a run longer than the very-long duration threshold (see Athlete Config), classification should be Very long / Race sim, Modality = Trail running, with Hill modifier if elevation exceeds 40 m/km. Time-of-day is derived from the activity start time.
expectations: Correctly identifies the longest run of the previous calendar month
PURPOSE is derived from duration and distance against the athlete's thresholds (Very long / Race sim if above the very-long threshold)
MODALITY is Trail running (or Road running, matching the activity type)
TIME matches the activity start time window
Output includes distance and elevation figures from the actual activity data

evals.prompt: Tag my short, steep trail run (under 15 km, under 90 min, more than 60 m/km elevation)
evals.expected_output: A short steep trail run: classified as Aerobic base (below the long-effort distance and duration thresholds). Hill modifier fires (elevation per km above 40 m/km). Technical terrain must NOT fire when the slow pace is fully explained by the elevation (ratio of actual to elevation-adjusted expected pace close to 1.0, using the 6.75 min/km baseline plus 0.06 min/km per m/km of elevation).
expectations: PURPOSE is Aerobic base (distance and duration are below the Long effort thresholds)
Hill modifier is applied (elevation per km exceeds 40 m/km threshold)
Technical terrain modifier is NOT applied (pace is fully explained by the elevation gain, ratio close to 1.0)
MODALITY is Trail running
TIME matches the activity start time window

evals.prompt: Tag my long, moderately hilly trail run (over 90 min, about 20-25 m/km elevation)
evals.expected_output: A long trail run over 90 min: Long effort. Hill modifier does NOT fire (below 40 m/km). Technical terrain: must use the Long effort baseline (7.5 min/km): expected = 7.5 + (m/km x 0.06). When actual pace is about 1.15-1.2x the expected pace, the ratio is below the 1.25 threshold, so technical terrain does NOT fire. A naive model using the Aerobic base baseline (6.75) would incorrectly flag this run as technical.
expectations: PURPOSE is Long effort (duration exceeds 90 min threshold)
Hill modifier is NOT applied (elevation per km is below 40 m/km threshold)
Technical terrain modifier is NOT applied (Long effort baseline of 7.5 min/km gives a ratio below the 1.25 threshold)
TIME matches the activity start time window
Why section references the pace calculation showing elevation-adjusted expected pace
